Créez ou importez une session, puis doub: Create or import a session, then double-click to connect. Folders start collapsed. Name/IP search includes all folders. Drag a session onto a folder to move it. In the session editor, use + New folder, then Create and select.
SSH intégré utilise le mot de passe sais: Integrated SSH uses a password, the vault, a private key or the SSH agent. Verify new server fingerprints independently. Changed keys are blocked. SFTP opens the right panel. Double-click a folder to enter, use ↑ to go up, Ctrl+click to select multiple items. Upload accepts files or a folder. Download recursively copies the selection into a local folder. Existing items and symbolic links are rejected. An error or interruption may leave partial files: remove these before retrying. SFTP requires server support and another SSH connection. External OpenSSH is available in SSH / tunnel options without the integrated file browser.
Paramètres > Coffre et mot de passe maît: Settings > Vault and master password creates the encrypted vault and migrates existing secrets. Minimum 12 characters; use a long unique passphrase. The vault starts locked. Unlock it in Settings. Password… on a session saves/deletes its secret; the SSH login also offers Save in vault. Manual locking closes connections. After 10 minutes without interaction, the master vault locks and closes connections. This is not OS lock detection. Back up vault.json, vault.enabled, remotehub.db and preferences.json with the app closed. A lost master password cannot be recovered. See securite.txt for algorithms and limitations.
Créez une session SSH pour la passerelle: Create an SSH gateway session, connect once to verify its fingerprint, and save its password or configure a key/agent. Right-click the target > SSH / tunnel options > select the gateway. One hop is supported. SSH, RDP, VNC and Web use a random port bound only to 127.0.0.1. The gateway must allow TCP forwarding. Keep the tab open. Web uses a local URL: HTTPS certificates and sites requiring their DNS hostname may be incompatible; TLS validation is never disabled. Proprietary MobaXterm tunnel settings are not imported.
Volets visibles affiche 1 à 6 connexions: Visible panes displays 1–6 connections; other tabs stay open. Each pane and tab has a ▾ menu to select an open connection. Rename tab changes its title for this run. Click inside a terminal to focus keyboard input. Multi-execution lets you select terminals, enter one or more lines, check recipients, then execute. Each line is sent with Enter; output stays in each terminal. Prompts are not detected: do not select a terminal waiting for a password or confirmation.
RDP lance mstsc sous Windows ou FreeRDP: RDP launches mstsc on Windows or FreeRDP on Linux. VNC uses a TigerVNC-compatible host::port client. Configure paths in Settings > External applications if needed. These clients keep their own window and authentication: HostGates never passes passwords in arguments. Web opens HTTP(S) in the default browser. RDP/VNC passwords can be stored in the vault but are not automatically filled into external clients.
File > Import MobaXterm supports .mxtsessions, .moba, .ini and CSV. SSH mode 0, RDP 4, VNC 5, Web 11. Review the preview and duplicates before importing. MobaXterm passwords are not decrypted. CSV export is recommended; .mxtsessions covers known fields only. Secrets and HostGates gateway settings are never exported. An export is not a complete backup.
SSH intégré ne nécessite pas ssh.exe, ma: Integrated SSH needs no ssh.exe, but requires a reachable SSH server and a valid username. Password, private key and libssh2-compatible agent authentication are supported; some Windows keys/agents may require external OpenSSH. SFTP and tunnels use the same host-key policy. Configure RDP/VNC/local terminal executables in Settings > External applications, check and save. On failure, check VPN, firewall, port, account, SFTP permissions and forwarding authorization. Linux builds require OpenSSL and pkg-config development packages. No security certification; testing on a real Linux desktop is still required.
